# Ranzospace: full reference

> Ranzospace is an interior design and architecture studio in Mumbai, India. Founded in 2018, it designs and delivers residential, commercial and hospitality spaces from first sketch to handover, with civil, carpentry, electrical, plumbing, false ceiling, flooring and painting managed by its own team.

Canonical site: https://ranzospace.in
Short index: https://ranzospace.in/llms.txt

## Quick facts
- Name: Ranzospace
- Type: Interior design and architecture studio
- Location: Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
- Service area: Mumbai, Thane and Navi Mumbai
- Founded: 2018
- Founder: Ar. Manas Makwana (the team also includes Umesh and supporting designers and project managers)
- Completed projects: 100+
- Experience: 8+ years
- Quality control: 140 quality checks per project before handover
- Email: info@ranzospace.in
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 96991 47145
- Response time: within 24 hours
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/ranzospace
- LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/company/ranzospace

## Studio timeline
- 2018: Started with architecture and interiors.
- 2020: Introduced AI design and simulation.
- 2022: Expanded into large-scale projects.
- 2024: Moved into the premium market.
- 2025: Launched an AI-integrated design pipeline.

## Philosophy
Ranzospace designs spaces for living rather than for photographs. Four principles guide the work: vision over validation (telling clients what a space needs), substance before style, accountability by default (own timelines, costs and outcomes), and design that compounds (spaces that feel better each year).

## Services

### Interior Design
URL: https://ranzospace.in/services/interior-design
Full-home and commercial interiors covering kitchens, bedrooms, living areas, workspaces and storage, designed as a unified whole.
Included: 2D and 3D floor plans, AI-powered 360 degree simulations, material and finish specification, custom furniture design, lighting design, civil and structural works, carpentry and joinery, electrical and plumbing, false ceiling and flooring, paint specification, decor sourcing, and a 140-point quality check.
Process: 1) Discovery call, 2) Site analysis, 3) Concept development with 3D simulations, 4) Material selection, 5) Execution, 6) Handover.

### Architecture
URL: https://ranzospace.in/services/architecture
Architecture and space planning from initial concept to construction documentation.
Included: site analysis and feasibility, schematic design, 3D volumetric modelling, building permit documentation, structural coordination, MEP integration, material specification, construction drawings, site supervision and contractor coordination.
Process: 1) Brief and site study, 2) Concept design, 3) Design development, 4) Construction documents, 5) Site supervision.

### Furniture and Decor
URL: https://ranzospace.in/services/furniture
Modular furniture and curated decor: sofas, beds, wardrobes, dining tables, kitchen systems and accent pieces, sourced to suit the room and the budget.
Process: 1) Discovery, 2) Curated shortlist, 3) Sample and finish approval, 4) Sourcing and fabrication, 5) Delivery and installation by the studio's own team.

### Design Consultation
URL: https://ranzospace.in/services/design-consultation
A pre-project consultation that gives clarity before a full commitment.
Process: 1) The brief, 2) Site walk-through, 3) A focused consultation on direction, spatial changes, materials, budget and timeline, 4) A written report with agreed direction and next steps.

## Frequently asked questions

**What does Ranzospace do?**
Ranzospace is a Mumbai interior design and architecture studio. It designs and builds homes, offices and hospitality spaces, and also supplies custom furniture and decor.

**Where is Ranzospace based and where does it work?**
The studio is in Mumbai, India, and works across Mumbai, Thane and Navi Mumbai.

**Does Ranzospace handle execution as well as design?**
Yes. On-site execution is included across all services: civil work, tiling, carpentry, electrical, plumbing, false ceiling, flooring and painting are managed by the studio's own team, so the client receives one finished project.

**What is the 140-point quality check?**
Every project goes through 140 quality checks before handover, covering the work done on site. The studio describes this as part of its accountability promise.

**Can I see my space before it is built?**
Yes. Interior projects include AI-powered 3D simulations and 360 degree views so the space can be reviewed and revised before work starts.

**Does Ranzospace work on commercial and hospitality spaces?**
Yes. Past work includes residences, a clinic and other commercial spaces, in addition to full-home interiors.

**What is a design consultation?**
A pre-project session covering design direction, materials and budget. It includes a site walk-through and ends in a written report that becomes the foundation of the project.

**Does Ranzospace make custom furniture?**
Yes. Wardrobes, consoles, kitchens, study units and other pieces are designed to fit the space and fabricated with vetted workshops, then delivered and installed by the studio.

**How do I contact Ranzospace?**
Use the form at https://ranzospace.in/contact, email info@ranzospace.in, call or WhatsApp +91 96991 47145. The studio replies within 24 hours.

**What happens to the details I submit?**
Only the name, phone number, email and project notes typed into the enquiry forms are collected. They are used to reply to the enquiry and are never sold. See https://ranzospace.in/privacy.
